ModMetaData.name: Raiders Inherit
ModMetaData.author: Sk
ModMetaData.description: Replaces the vanilla "Man in Black" recovery event with something a bit more fitting: when your colony's last colonist falls to an enemy raid, you inherit the raid itself instead of a lone stranger wandering in. A configurable number of the surviving raiders join your colony immediately; the rest are released as non-hostile allies and leave the map peacefully, so nobody is left behind to turn around and attack your new colonists.
